observations: Photo 0 shows a silver portable speaker with a handle, front grille, and control buttons. The screen displays 'Bending My Way (Live)' and 'Neon Radio'.
Photo 1 shows the same speaker from a slightly different angle, with the screen still displaying the same song and time. The speaker appears to be in good condition with no visible damage.

Photo 2 is a close-up of the back label showing 'MONDO BT SPEAKER LARGE', 'Input: 5V 3A 9V 3A', 'Capacity: 6000mAh/66.0Wh', 'FCC ID: 2AKFED200', 'Designed by a Star AB', 'Hollandskolan 22, 113 09 Stockholm, Sweden'.
Photo 3 shows the speaker from a side angle, with the screen still active. The speaker has a textured front grille and a handle on top.
The speaker is described as a 'great and powerful speaker' and 'all keys and buttons working'.

claims.evidence: Subjective claim; no objective proof of power or sound quality in photos.
Photos 0, 1, and 3 show the screen active and buttons visible, but no video or audio test is provided to confirm functionality.
No adapter is visible in any photo. The seller's text claims it is included, but it is not shown.

claims.claim: Bought from the UK, no dead key, no crackle.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.proof: Video showing the speaker playing for 10 minutes after being unplugged from power.

risks.proof: Photo of the adapter included with the speaker.

Photo of the adapter included with the speaker.

response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
